transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in today?

I'm here because I've been dealing with this overflowing energy and hyperactivity for the past nine months, and I just can't seem to sit still. My mood has also been swinging unpredictably from being extremely high to suddenly very irritated. It's gotten to the point where I really need some help managing it.

Have you ever had a period of at least one week where your mood was abnormally elevated or irritable and you had much more energy than usual, along with needing much less sleep, feeling unusually confident, or doing risky things?

Yes, I've definitely experienced those extremely elevated, euphoric, or highly irritable moods for about nine months now. I have this overflowing physical and mental energy that makes me feel like I can never stay still and always need to keep moving. I'm not really sure about needing less sleep or doing risky things, though.
Did you have problems with inattention, hyperactivity, or impulsivity starting in childhood, before age 12, and have they been present most of the time since then?
No, I didn't have those kinds of problems when I was a child. All of this hyperactivity and intense energy is a much more recent issue that only started within the last year.
During these high-energy periods, have you ever had to be hospitalized, or had hallucinations, delusions, or a loss of touch with reality?

Yes, during those high-energy times, I've definitely experienced hallucinations and delusions, like hearing voices and feeling like I'm being watched. What's scary is that these strange experiences and losing touch with reality also happen sometimes even when I'm not feeling that high energy at all.
Do the hallucinations or delusions ever last for at least two weeks when your mood is not elevated or depressed?

Yes, that definitely happens. I've had periods of two weeks or even longer where my mood is completely normal and stable, but I still hear those voices and feel convinced people are out to get me. The mind tricks don't seem to stop just because my mood is calm.
Do the hallucinations or delusions ever last for at least two weeks when your mood is not elevated or depressed?

Yes, absolutely. There have been several times lasting at least two weeks where I've heard voices and felt monitored, even though my mood was completely normal and stable. During those weeks, I wasn't feeling high, energetic, or depressed at all, but those experiences still happened.

final_diagnosis.reason: The patient has a prolonged manic-spectrum episode with elevated/irritable mood and increased energy lasting months, plus hallucinations and delusions. Critically, psychotic symptoms also occur for at least 2 weeks when mood is normal, which rules out bipolar I disorder with psychotic features and supports schizoaffective disorder. Bipolar type is favored because the mood episodes are elevated/irritable rather than depressive.
